people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.
translations.bsb: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin, and the house of Ephraim, and Israel was in deep distress.
translations.kjv: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
translations.asv: And the children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
